skill.summary: Analyze user's conversation to identify unclear parts and suggest better questions. Helps users express their problems more clearly.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added initial release of clarify-me: analyzes conversations to identify unclear parts and suggest clearer questions.
- Supports explicit triggers in English and Chinese.
- Provides friendly, specific feedback with examples, quoting vague phrases and suggesting improvements.
- No configuration required; activated only by explicit user request.
